subtasks.title: Direct Orders zero-zone fallback (+ tests + Help copy)
subtasks.approach: In ClarityScoutMapController::heatmapOrders(), compute $hasAssignedZones = $user->zones()->exists() ONCE before the layer loop. Inside the loop, apply clipRowsToAssignedZones() to Staging ALWAYS, and to Direct only when $hasAssignedZones is true — i.e. guard the clip with `if ($staging || $hasAssignedZones)`. With zero assigned zones, Direct passes through unclipped and falls back to the org-wide run-area/bbox density (the query already clips to run-area+viewport). Staging behavior is unchanged (still empty when no zones — the AC#4 nudge). Update the heatmapOrders() docblock (:417-419) and clipRowsToAssignedZones() docblock (:624-628) to describe the Direct zero-zone fallback. TDD: invert the one test that pins the old behavior, confirm red→green. Then reword the HelpPanel.vue Direct copy and rebuild committed assets.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
app/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutMapController.php: (1) before `foreach ($layers as $layer)` at ~:449 add `$hasAssignedZones = $user->zones()->exists();` with a comment; (2) change `$rows = $this->clipRowsToAssignedZones($rows, $user);` at :452 to `if ($staging || $hasAssignedZones) { $rows = $this->clipRowsToAssignedZones($rows, $user); }`; (3) rewrite docblock :417-419 and :624-628 to state Staging is always zone-clipped while Direct is clipped only when the driver has zones (org-wide fallback otherwise, DEV-2278).
tests/.../ClarityScoutMapControllerTest.php: (1) invert test_heatmap_orders_direct_is_empty_without_assigned_zones (:1154) → rename to test_heatmap_orders_direct_renders_org_wide_without_assigned_zones and assert the seeded in-run-area Direct cell IS present (not `features:[]`); (2) fix the stale comment at :1104 ('Direct ignores zones either way') to reflect that with a zone assigned Direct is clipped to the zone (the zone covers the shared cell). Leave test_heatmap_orders_direct_clips_to_assigned_zones (:1130), the staging tests, and the plate-length tests unchanged — they remain correct.
resources/js/clarity-scout/components/HelpPanel.vue: reword :158 and :346 so Direct is described as clipped to your zone(s) when you have any, org-wide when you have none; Staging always clipped; Live Hit Density always org-wide. Then `npm run build`, revert boost-doc regen (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .junie/guidelines.md), and commit the rebuilt public/build assets.

excluded_sites.reason: Bird's Eye org-map clips by org run-area, not per-user assigned zones; not implicated by this bug. (Its heatmap endpoints lack test coverage — separate follow-up, not this ticket.)
Zone clip already opt-in (org-wide fallback); working layer, unchanged.
Method body unchanged; only its call-site gating for Direct changes. Its empty-on-no-zones behavior is still correct for Staging and for Direct-with-zones.

notes: test_filter ClarityScoutMapControllerTest is a RequiresClickhouse class → Phase 4 must ensure the local ClickHouse container (data_impact.ch_tables non-empty).
